constraints: BUDGET: 0 ₸; inputs say no ad budget (default)

OWNER: ≤15 min at onboarding and ≤5 min/week in one batched message. There is no direct owner contact yet; everything goes through Andrey (MetaPrompt) and Pavel, so plan for delayed answers (stated / evidence).
STAFF: 20 min/week stated, so ≤17 planned min/week. One mid/low-quality phone (stated).
AUDIO: audio is good only with the phone close to the instrument (stated). Instrument sound recorded at 20–30 cm. Speech only with the phone ≤30–40 cm from the mouth. No wide shots with dialogue.

FILMING: hands, instruments and voice only. No faces until staff consent is asked and recorded. Customers only with consent recorded on camera. Minors only with a parent's written OK (default; consent not yet asked, per evidence).

PRICES: only prices fetched from muzzone.kz within the last 7 days, re-fetched on publish day. The Casio PX-770 BKC7 page showed 695 913 ₸ on 2026-10-08 and 521 935 ₸ on 2026-10-09, so prices move. Never publish a price that doesn't match the site on the day (evidence).

STOCK: «в наличии» or quantities only from a site fetch ≤48 h old. No «осталось N» or scarcity wording without an owner-confirmed count re-checked on publish day, even when the site shows a quantity, e.g. 1 pc for some sale cymbals (default + evidence).

OFFER: no new offers. Sale prices and old prices already on the site (sale_page, hib_old/hib_price, mapex_old/mapex_price) may be shown exactly as published. Do not use «Финальная», closure or brand-exit reasons, or end dates until the owner confirms them (evidence: sale_page reason unknown).

CLAIMS: the site's «100% оригинальный товар» is the business's own claim, so it cannot be an audience claim (C6.3: needs a third-party source). The returns line may only be used with its conditions (returns_14d + returns_conditions + returns_cost: delivery both ways is withheld). Videos and quick replies will never mention or promote the site clause that refunds delivery in exchange for a review or video, because it is an incentivised-review mechanism (evidence).

CAPACITY: retail stock and delivery across Kazakhstan (delivery_free_100k, delivery_astana, pickup_reserve). Per-SKU stock is limited (e.g. PX-770: 3 pcs, AP-270: 5 pcs on 2026-10-09). No «завтра» or fast-delivery claims. Conversion content features only SKUs re-checked as in stock ≤48 h (evidence).
HOURS: calls Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–17:00 (fact: hours). WhatsApp reply hours are unknown, so CTAs promise nothing outside those hours (evidence / default).
REGULATED: not a regulated category. For children's instruments, make no learning-outcome promises (e.g. «научится за месяц») (default).
AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers or players, naming competitors (other music shops or Kaspi sellers) (default)

ACCOUNTS: Instagram muzzone_astana exists but was not analysed (it blocks anonymous fetch). YouTube has 3 620 subscribers and 379 videos, with the last upload on 2026-05-10. VK and Facebook exist. TikTok is unknown, so it is an owner ask. Music: original instrument audio first; commercial library only on business accounts (evidence / default).
LANGUAGE: Russian audience copy. Kazakh captions only after a native speaker checks them (default).
APPROVAL: the owner, via Andrey or Pavel, approves each weekly batch explicitly. Offers, faces and any spend always need explicit approval (default).
GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min in working hours, measured from the week-0 export (default)
GUARDRAIL: zero published prices or stock statements that differ from the site on the publish date, and zero credibly disputed facts in comments; if one appears, apply DR11 the same day (default)
assumptions: BOTTLENECK: awareness on short-form, low–medium confidence. Evidence: no TikTok linked; YouTube has had no uploads since 2026-05-10; Instagram is unanalysed; L006 shows brand-only demos without a buyer question had a median of 390 views vs the 2 300 channel median. REALISM: the boss gave no number, so the target is derived from capacity. ach_views = 20 base posts (5/week × 4) × 3 platforms × [ASSUMPTION] 500 median views × 1.8 ≈ 54 000. At [ASSUMPTION] 0.3–3 chats/1k that gives 16–162 coded chats. Expected (40) needs ≥0.74/1k (ratio ≈1, feasible-to-stretch). Stretch (80) needs ≥1.5/1k (ratio ≈2, stretch). insights.insight: [tension] When someone in Astana decides to start electric guitar, either for themselves or for a teenager, they want to play a recognisable song soon. But they fear paying for a guitar that is wrong for a beginner, or one that gets abandoned. So they binge long «для начинающих» reviews and postpone the purchase: the store's beginner-framed videos ran at 6.7× the channel median, and the X100 beginner video at 27.8×. We can show the actual in-stock beginner electrics played at 30 cm in the salesroom: the AS-100BK at 59 800 ₸ with 11 pcs, and the Cort X100 Black Cherry Burst, the same model as the 64k video, once re-fetched into the ledger. We can add the published 14-day return with its real conditions. Suitability is framed as «мастер считает», never as a fact. This moves coded WhatsApp chats because «пришлите бюджет — подберём и покажем видео этой гитары» is the natural next step for someone stuck choosing.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When a beginner prices an electric guitar, they want the whole budget to buy a good guitar. But an electric guitar is near-silent without an amp, and nobody tells them how to split the money. Interest in this split is real: «Marshall CODE vs Fender Mustang GT для дома» got 10.4× the median, while the store's own abstract «дешёвая гитара + дорогой усилитель» test got only 1.1×, so the question works when it is concrete, not abstract. As a result they overspend on the guitar and buy any small amp later, or postpone. We can show a concrete in-stock pair: the AS-100BK through the Hibilly Retro 30R, which is on the site at 56 576 ₸ instead of 70 720 ₸. The amp sound is recorded at 30 cm. The pair totals 116 376 ₸, which crosses the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery threshold (a derived fact that needs a ledger entry). This moves chats because «соберём комплект под ваш бюджет» is a concrete WhatsApp ask that raises order value without a new discount.

insights.insight: [moment] In autumn, once the music-school year is under way (calendar inference), parents of a child who has started piano need a home instrument. So they postpone or settle for a cheaper keyboard. The store has hosted children trying pianos on camera (the «Юные гости» series), and 14 of 25 sampled pianos are in stock across a 200 720 – 2 075 617 ₸ range. insights.who_feels_it: Parents in Astana (and other cities via delivery) whose child started music school or piano lessons this autumn and has no proper instrument at home
insights.content_reality: «зона пианино»: hands play the same scale on the PX-770 and AP-270 with the phone 20 cm above the keys. A pedal close-up, and a shot of the empty space where a bench would be (bench not included). Prices only after a same-day re-fetch, since the PX-770 moved 695 913 → 521 935 ₸ in one day. Children on camera only with a parent's written OK; default is hands only. Moment evidence is an assumption.

insights.insight: [proof] When buyers shop for an instrument online, they want to know how this exact instrument sounds and feels. But the site offers catalogue photos, spec tables and almost no reviews: 11 of 12 product records have no rating. So they either come to the store, which is hard outside Astana and outside the store's hours, or buy on specs alone. The weak phone's one real strength is close audio. We can record the actual in-stock unit at 20–30 cm and offer «пришлём видео именно этого экземпляра» in WhatsApp. L006 shows brand-only sound demos flop (median 390), so the proof must answer a buyer's question, not just play a riff. This moves coded chats because the CTA promises something only a real shop with the item in hand can deliver.
insights.tension: Wants to hear and see the exact unit before paying vs only has photos and spec tables with no reviews, which leads to a store visit, a guess, or no purchase
insights.who_feels_it: Remote or busy buyers comparing instruments online, especially outside Astana or outside the store's opening hours
insights.content_reality: «торговый зал» and «зона пианино»: the same unit's serial label or headstock in frame, then sound at 20–30 cm with no music over it. «Видео этого экземпляра» is a staff-deliverable CTA. Needs an owner OK that staff will send unit videos in chat.

insights.insight: [friction] When someone outside Astana, or anyone spending 300k+ ₸, considers ordering through WhatsApp, they want to be sure they won't be stuck. But «гарантия/возврат» claims are everywhere, and the real terms have catches: delivery both ways is withheld on a return, items must be unused with the packaging kept, and Casio service is in Almaty only. So they hesitate (inferred; no chat data yet). The store has published, specific terms: a 14-day return with conditions, a minimum 12-month warranty, free delivery over 100 000 ₸, and Kaspi and card payments. Stating them exactly, including the unflattering parts, is an honest signal that is believed more than slogans. This moves conversion of high-ticket and remote chats. The review-for-delivery-compensation clause is excluded.
insights.tension: Wants a safe remote or high-ticket purchase vs distrusts generic guarantees and fears hidden return costs, which leads to hesitation or many questions
insights.who_feels_it: Buyers in other Kazakh cities ordering for delivery, and anyone about to pay for a piano, drum kit or premium guitar
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: a staff voice at 30 cm explains one term per episode over a screen recording of muzzone.kz/garantii-i-vozvrat.html, plus hands packing an instrument. Only exact policy wording; no «без проблем», no «100%».

insights.insight: [friction] When a viewer sees a specific in-stock instrument in an evening video, they want to secure that unit. But per-SKU stock is small (PX-770: 3, Hibilly: 2, Mapex Comet: 1; 12 of 29 in-stock sampled sale items are single units), calls close at 19:00 (17:00 on Saturday), and they can't come until the weekend. So they risk it or forget. The store already publishes a non-price offer: a pickup reserve of 3 working days, extendable on request. «Напишите {CODE} — отложим на 3 рабочих дня» turns late-night interest into a coded chat without any scarcity claim. Quantities are never shown as «осталось N».
insights.tension: Wants to lock in the exact unit seen in the video vs can't visit or call in time, which leads to a lost impulse
insights.who_feels_it: Working adults who browse in the evening and can only reach the store on weekends; out-of-town buyers deciding over several days
insights.content_reality: «торговый зал»: hands attach a «Отложено» tag (paper, staff-made) to an instrument. The reserve rule is on screen from the dostavka-i-oplata page. No stock counts, no urgency. This feeds CTA and quick-reply wording more than standalone videos.

insights.insight: [price_value] When someone picks a ukulele, whether as a gift, an adult hobby or a child's first instrument, they want a real instrument, not a toy. But online all concert ukuleles look alike, and they can't hear what +10 801 ₸ or +42 401 ₸ buys. So they choose by colour or by the lowest price. The store has exactly three in-stock concert ukuleles at 22 100, 32 901 and 64 501 ₸. All come with a case, and they differ visibly in top wood (ель / массив ели / клён). We can play the same chord on each at 20 cm and let viewers guess which is which before the reveal, with no claim about which sounds «better». This moves coded chats («пришлём звук каждой — выберете на слух»), and as a cheap line it suits the gift-season test next sprint.
insights.tension: Wants a 'real' ukulele at a sensible price vs can't hear the difference between price tiers online, which leads to choosing by colour or cheapest
insights.who_feels_it: Gift-givers, adult hobby beginners and parents choosing a first instrument with a budget under about 65k ₸
insights.content_reality: «торговый зал»: three ukuleles side by side, the same strum on each with the phone 20 cm from the soundhole, and the case unzipped at the end. All evidence comes from the site only (single source), so strength is capped at 3. There is no demand data for ukuleles on the own channel.

insights.insight: [content_reality] Outsiders never hear what separates a 75k ₸ cymbal from a 300k ₸ hi-hat, or what a full drum kit sounds like up close, and drummers love comparing. The sale floor is mostly percussion: 27 of 40 sampled sale items are drum kits, cymbals or hardware, and many are single units with published old prices. On the own channel, brand-only cymbal clips flopped (median 390), but a few ultra-short sound clips broke out (PST7 China 13 000 in 34 s, cajón 6 900 in 23 s). Sound-led percussion is therefore a high-variance wildcard for reach. It is tied to a guess («какая дороже?») so it isn't a brand demo. Conversion is limited to upgrading drummers, and staff must solve mic clipping.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity gap: «снаружи никто не слышит разницу между тарелками за 75 и 300 тысяч»; drummers want to hear before buying
insights.who_feels_it: Drummers in Astana and across Kazakhstan considering an upgrade; casual viewers who stop for loud, satisfying sound
insights.content_reality: «торговый зал»: a single soft stroke on each cymbal with the phone about 1 m away (clipping risk), and a stick-tip macro. Prices only from a same-day site fetch with the old price as published. No «последняя», no «финальная».

insights.insight: [myth] WILDCARD. When a beginner or parent asks people around them what to start on, they often hear «начинать надо с акустики/классики, электро — потом». This is a widespread CIS belief (assumption: no customer evidence yet). So beginners who dream of rock or pop songs buy a classical guitar they don't enjoy. The store's reality points the other way: beginner electrics are in stock (AS-100BK, 11 pcs), budget acoustic and classical guitars are mostly out of stock, and the channel's biggest hits are beginner electrics. A myth_check framed strictly as the staff musician's opinion («мастер считает»), showing both guitars played at 30 cm, could surface strong comment splits. It must never claim «электро легче» as a fact.
insights.tension: Wants to play the music they actually like vs believes they must «suffer» through classical guitar first, which leads to the wrong first instrument or quitting
insights.who_feels_it: Teens and adults who want to play rock or pop songs, and parents being advised by relatives or teachers
insights.content_reality: «торговый зал»: the AS-100BK vs whatever acoustic is in stock (the cheapest in-stock one is 76 960 ₸), the same riff, phone at 30 cm. Opinion only and no proof of «easier», so this is recognition and opinion content. The belief is unverified until the chat or comments show it.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] WILDCARD. When a new instrument is carried home or delivered in Astana frost, the owner wants to open it and play immediately. Common luthier practice, which staff must confirm, is to let it warm up in its closed case first, so they risk finish or neck problems without knowing it. The store ships by ground across Kazakhstan and winter starts within this sprint. A short «мастер советует» care clip is save-worthy, seasonal reference content. It is untested: the one care how-to on the channel underperformed long-form (854 views), so the score stays honestly low.
insights.tension: Wants to play the new instrument right away vs doesn't know the cold-to-warm risk, which leads to opening the case at once
insights.who_feels_it: New buyers carrying instruments home in winter, and delivery customers in other cities receiving parcels in frost
insights.content_reality: «торговый зал» doorway: a hand sets a closed case down, then a time-skip text card. A staff voice at 30 cm in «тихий угол» says what the master advises. The practice is not a store fact; the owner or staff confirm it before production.

But they fear a cheap guitar will sound like a toy, and they can't judge sound from a catalogue. So they hunt for «для начинающих» model videos and delay, or ask around. We can show the 59 800 ₸ AS-100BK (11 in stock) plugged into the Hibilly Retro 30R, played by staff hands with the phone at the amp, clean then drive. That pair crosses the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery line. This moves coded guitar+amp chats because it answers the one doubt that blocks the order: does it sound real?
insights.tension: Want to start cheap vs fear that cheap = toy sound and money wasted
insights.who_feels_it: A beginner, or the parent of a teen, choosing a first electric guitar in the next few weeks, in Astana or ordering for delivery
insights.content_reality: Hands on the AS-100BK, phone 20–30 cm from the Hibilly speaker at «гитарная стена» (provisional name). Proof is the sound itself. Prices are ledger-backed but expire 2026-10-15, so re-fetch. The cheapest ladder rung is ledger; the Cort X100 (98 280 ₸) needs a ledger fact first.

insights.insight: [moment] When a buyer has narrowed down to a specific model, they type the model name into YouTube or TikTok to hear it before paying. They want to hear the exact instrument, but most results are long reviews of other units. So they watch 5-minute demos or guess. Our short plain-name clips already catch this moment (Cort AD810BKS 32 000 in 83 s; Squier Contemporary Active 17 000 in 78 s). We can post 15–30 s sound clips of in-stock SKUs titled with the exact model, which is cheap and searchable. This moves coded chats about named models because the viewer is already at the decision step.
insights.tension: Ready to buy a named model vs can't hear this exact one without a long review or a trip
insights.who_feels_it: A musician or parent who has already shortlisted 1–2 models and is checking sound before paying
insights.content_reality: One in-stock instrument per clip, played at 20–30 cm at «гитарная стена» / «зал с пианино» (provisional). Also re-cuts of the 379-video library. This is a search line (L004), and L003 warns title tricks don't transfer to Shorts. It is measured separately.

insights.insight: [price_value] When a child is a year or more into music school, parents must buy an 88-key digital piano. They want one that lasts years, but the shelf runs from 200 720 ₸ to 2 075 617 ₸. On paper the PX-770 (521 935 ₸) and AP-270 (734 886 ₸) differ mainly in polyphony, 128 vs 192, for 212 951 ₸. Neither includes a bench. So parents copy the teacher's advice or default to cheapest or most expensive. We can play the same phrase on both, phone at the keys and speaker, and say plainly what the extra money buys and what it doesn't. This moves high-ticket coded chats by turning an unjudgeable spec sheet into an audible choice.
insights.tension: Want the right piano for years vs can't hear or understand a 200k+ ₸ difference
insights.who_feels_it: Parents of a music-school pupil in Astana, or out of town via delivery, choosing a first serious piano this autumn
insights.content_reality: Hands on two Casio pianos side by side at «зал с пианино» (provisional), phone 20–30 cm from the speaker. Piano prices are volatile (E23), so re-fetch on publish day or show no price. No child on camera without a parent's written OK.

insights.insight: [proof] When a buyer finds a model on the site, they want to be sure it's actually there and that the unit they'll get is fine. But 54% of sampled listings show «нет в наличии», and a delivery return costs them both-way shipping. So they hesitate, phone, or buy where stock looks certain. We can film the exact in-stock unit on request, with serial-free close-ups and the sound, and send it in WhatsApp before payment. This moves coded chats to orders, especially out of town, because it removes the 'what will actually arrive' risk.
insights.tension: Want certainty about this exact unit vs site often says unavailable and a remote return is costly
insights.who_feels_it: Buyers outside Astana or busy buyers who won't visit, choosing an instrument over 100 000 ₸ for free delivery
insights.content_reality: Staff hands filming one instrument off the wall, a 10 s strum or keys, at «гитарная стена». The 'video of your exact unit' promise needs owner approval as a non-price offer, so until then only recognition and process content.

insights.insight: [friction] When someone buys an expensive instrument, especially by delivery, they want to know what happens if it disappoints or breaks. The real terms are a 14-day return for unused goods, with delivery both ways withheld; a 12-month minimum warranty; and Casio's 2-year warranty, serviced only in Almaty. Buyers either don't read them or fear a hidden catch, so they postpone. We can tell these rules straight, including the inconvenient parts, as a short policy story. Admitting the cost builds trust and pre-empts returns (guardrail).
insights.tension: Want a safety net on a big purchase vs the safety net has real costs nobody explains up front
insights.who_feels_it: Anyone about to pay 100 000–750 000 ₸ for an instrument they can't fully test at home first
insights.content_reality: Voice-over recorded at «тихий угол» with the phone at the mouth, over hands-on-instrument B-roll and an anonymised policy card. Every line maps to returns_14d, returns_cost, warranty and warranty_casio. Never mention the review-for-compensation clause.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When a first-time buyer prices an instrument, they want the total cost. But they don't know what's in the box: the pianos come without a bench, the electric guitar needs an amp, and the ukuleles include a case. So they get surprised in the chat or after delivery. We can show, item by item on the counter, what comes with each instrument and what doesn't. This moves conversion because a complete, honest basket gets fewer stalls after the price and lets us build orders over the 100 000 ₸ delivery threshold.
insights.tension: Want to know the full price vs the listing hides what's missing
insights.who_feels_it: A first-time buyer, or a gift buyer, who doesn't play yet and can't tell what else is needed
insights.content_reality: Hands unboxing or laying out items at «гитарная стена» / «зал с пианино». Only in-box facts that are in the ledger (bench «Нет», case «Да»). Cable and strap contents need NEEDS FACT before they are claimed.

insights.insight: [moment] When a holiday or birthday is coming, a gift buyer wants something that will be played rather than left in a cupboard. But they fear a cheap ukulele is junk and can't tell why one costs 22 100 ₸ and another 64 501 ₸. So they buy random or not at all. We can play the three in-stock concert ukuleles (22 100 / 32 901 / 64 501 ₸, all with a case) in one take and show the difference in wood and sound. This moves coded ukulele chats and pre-tests the New Year gift line.
insights.tension: Want a gift that gets played vs can't judge cheap vs good
insights.who_feels_it: Someone buying a gift for a teen, partner or friend 1–6 weeks before a date
insights.content_reality: Three ukuleles strummed with the same chord at «гитарная стена», phone at 20 cm. Stock is thin (4 models in stock), so re-check. The gift timing is an assumption, so test now and scale later.

insights.insight: [content_reality] Outsiders never hear what a 218 400 ₸ cymbal or a full drum kit sounds like up close. Brand-only demos flop (median 390), but 21–34 s pure-sound clips broke out (cajon 6 900, splash 5 600, PST7 China 13 000). The sale list is mostly drums and cymbals, many with 1 unit. We can film single hits and decays at 20–30 cm as loops. This gives reach and pooled-arm data; conversion is weak and stock-limited.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity gap: «снаружи этого никто не слышит» (how big the difference in cymbals sounds up close)
insights.who_feels_it: Drummers and curious scrollers; the buyers are a narrow niche
insights.content_reality: Stick hits on in-stock cymbals or kit, phone 20–30 cm, at the drum corner (location name pending the reality scan). No conversion push on 1-unit SKUs without a same-day stock re-check.

insights.insight: [price_value] Wildcard. When a player has been eyeing gear, a 20–70% markdown pulls them in. But a sale labelled «Финальная» with no reason invites the doubt «почему так дёшево — что с ним?». So they wait or ask. We can show the exact discounted item, its sound and condition, at the published price (e.g. Hibilly 30R 56 576 ₸, was 70 720 ₸). This may move sale-stock chats, but the reason and the word «финальная» stay off screen until the owner answers.
insights.tension: Want the discount vs suspicion about why it's discounted
insights.who_feels_it: Musicians who already know the gear and watch prices, mostly drummers given the sale mix
insights.content_reality: Hands play the sale item at its shelf. Prices are shown only as published and re-fetched. The doubt itself is hypothesised, so no claims about why the item is cheap.

insights.insight: [identity] Wildcard. Musicians trust other musicians more than shops: person-led review and lesson channels outdraw store channels, and the shop's own masterclasses and blogger reviews were its big hits. A buyer wants advice from someone who plays, not a seller. We could build a recurring hands-and-voice character: «что играет продавец» on whatever just came in. This is untested; staff musicianship and consent are unknown.
insights.tension: Want a player's honest opinion vs distrust of a salesperson's pitch
insights.who_feels_it: Hobby musicians in Astana who follow players, not brands
insights.content_reality: Staff hands and voice only (phone at the mouth for opinions, at 20–30 cm for sound), at «гитарная стена». Opinions are framed as «продавец считает». Note that Mapex artist interviews flopped (68–233), so talking heads are out. Recognition content only until a willing player is confirmed.

output.name: Muzzone — «Послушайте, прежде чем платить» (Sprint 1, diagnostic sales push, 2026-10-12 → 2026-11-15)
output.big_idea: Online, a buyer can't judge an instrument from a spec sheet or a price tag. So for each in-stock instrument we play it up close in the Astana store: hands only, the phone 20–30 cm from the strings, keys or speaker. Then we say plainly what the whole start costs, what is in the box and what isn't, and what the honest drawbacks are. The buyer decides by ear and messages the code about that model. Episodes can be generated from the in-stock catalogue across pianos, guitars + amps, ukuleles and sale items (20+), each one is proven by the sound on camera, and each ends in a coded WhatsApp question about that exact model.
output.why_this_wins:
This is not a forecast (L1). It is a reasoned bet plus a learning plan.
(1) It sits on the strongest tension. I01 (strength 4; E01, E02, E12–E17, E50) is the fear that a cheap first guitar is a toy and the buyer can't hear it from a catalogue. The real sound of an AS-100BK through the Hibilly Retro 30R answers exactly that doubt. Prices come from as100_price and hib_price, re-fetched on publish day.
(2) The same mechanism carries the high-ticket line. I03 (E19–E24) shows PX-770 vs AP-270 differ on paper mainly in polyphony, 128 vs 192 (px770_specs, ap270_specs). ID08 and ID06 turn that spec sheet into an audible, honest choice. They also say the inconvenient parts: no bench, and Casio service only in Almaty (warranty_casio). Admitting a limit is believed, and it protects the returns guardrail (returns_cost).
(3) I06 (hidden total cost) and delivery_free_100k turn the content into a basket. Guitar 59 800 ₸ + amp 56 576 ₸ crosses the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery line (ID23). I07 pre-tests the gift line with ukuleles at 22 100 and 32 901 ₸, both with a case (u246_specs, usc40_specs).
(4) It avoids what already failed for this client. Brand-only demos scored a median 390 vs 2 300 (L006, n=48), and price slides are banned (L005). Every slate idea opens on motion and real sound, with no faces needed (consent not yet asked).
(5) The message «Послушайте, прежде чем платить» is true by construction: every episode plays the in-stock model. It is not a superiority claim. Whether peers already say it is an assumption, to be checked against the peer scan.
(6) Learning plan: in week 1, five posts across 5 drivers and 3 lines (guitar+amp, piano, ukulele). Week 2 adds two exploration arms (ID15 POV, ID19 ear test) and the zero-staff library line. Code allocates from 48 h data. On 2026-11-01 the targets are re-fixed against the week-0 inbound baseline. On 2026-11-15 the sprint answers which line converts per staff minute, and gives a pre-registered yes/no on whether social sells for Muzzone (the secondary should_we_do_social).

series.name: «Игрушка или нет?»
series.role: HERO. Funnel: attention→consideration. Metric: views_48h ÷ median, plus coded chats per 1k per line. Opening ritual (fixed): frame 1 is a hand already playing an in-stock instrument, phone 20–30 cm from the strings or speaker, real sound from 0.0 s, hook «[Инструмент] за [ledger price] — игрушка?» upper-middle. Structure: clean sound → one turn (gain, a different chord, a different register) → the viewer judges by ear → price line(s) from the same-day ledger → coded CTA. Variable per episode: the instrument. Each episode ≤3 staff min at one location. Ep. 1 = ID01. Later episodes, e.g. the ukulele U-246 at 22 100 ₸ or a sale item at its published price, come from the next step-4 batch (see risks: NEXT BATCH).
series.cadence: 1 in week 1 (ep. 1), then 2 per week from week 2 if next-batch episodes are approved; code may shift this by data

series.name: «Проверьте перед покупкой»
series.role: PROOF + UTILITY. Funnel: consideration. Metric: saves per 1k and the chat→order rate of coded piano and guitar chats. Opening ritual: hands already in motion on the instrument (glissando, jack click, hands on keys) plus a hook that names the purchase situation («Пианино в музыкалку…», «Первая электрогитара…», «Не переплачивайте…»). Structure: numbered checks or steps, each shown on a real item, ending in the honest limit (no bench, Casio service in Almaty).
series.cadence: 2 per week in weeks 1–2, then by allocation

series.name: «С чего начать»
series.role: CONVERSION. Funnel: conversion. Metric: coded chats per 1k views and orders above 100 000 ₸ (the delivery_free_100k basket). Opening ritual: an instrument placed or played in frame 1 for a named starter situation (a first electric guitar, a gift for someone who doesn't play). Structure: the full starter set with same-day ledger prices, then what's included (case «Да», bench «Нет»), then the free-delivery threshold if it is crossed, then a coded CTA that offers to assemble the set.
series.cadence: 2 per week in week 1, then 1–2 per week. Paused per SKU under the capacity/stock rule

series.name: «Звук вблизи»
series.role: REACH. Funnel: attention. Metric: relative views and shares per 1k. Opening ritual: sound onset in frame 1 and no talking, either a labelled POV over real footage or an ear test with A/B labels. Feeds pooled driver and format arms. Later cymbal and drum close-sound loops (I08) come from the next batch.
series.cadence: from week 2: 1–2 per week (wildcard and exploration slots)

series.name: «Ответ на комментарий»
series.role: REPLY. Funnel: retention/consideration. Metric: comments and follows per 1k. Starts once week-1 comments exist; answers to the comment prompts (e.g. «Банкетку покупали отдельно?», «А или Б?») become reply videos. No slate ids yet: next batch.
series.cadence: from week 2: 1 per week if real comments exist

offer.proposal: Новых скидок не предлагаем. Уже действует и упоминается точно как на сайте: «Бесплатная доставка по Казахстану при заказе свыше 100 000 ₸». Цены распродажи — только как опубликованы на сайте в день публикации, без слова «финальная» и без сроков. КАНДИДАТ (неценовое предложение, только после вашего «да»): «Напишите код из ролика в WhatsApp — до оплаты пришлём короткое видео именно того экземпляра, который вы покупаете: внешний вид и звук. Бесплатно, для товаров в наличии». Это тестируем как вариант (с предложением / без) в серии «С чего начать», начиная с недели 2.

channels.role: CONVERSION. This is where the primary metric is counted. Each video gets its own {CODE} (assigned by code), shown on screen for ≥2 s, in the caption and in the pinned comment, plus a prefilled wa.me link wherever links are clickable. Quick reply (Russian, drafted by the agent, approved once by the owner): «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {CODE}. Подскажите, для кого инструмент и на какой бюджет ориентируетесь, — сразу скажем, что из этого есть в наличии и что подойдёт.» Codeless chats get «Подскажите, откуда о нас узнали?». Handover reply asks for a 2GIS/Google review with no incentive; we never promote the site's «компенсация доставки за отзыв» clause. Staff labels: «Видео» and «Оплачен». Target: median first reply ≤15 min in working hours (пн–пт 10:00–19:00, сб 10:00–17:00, per the hours fact). If the week-0 export shows a median above 60 min, that is reported as the top leak and the conversion pieces wait (DR-reply).

Reach plus the shop window where KZ buyers check legitimacy. Account insights are unknown (anonymous fetch blocked), so we ask for screenshots. Pin 3 posts: ID01 (proof by sound), ID06 (best answer) and a «Как заказать» post (next batch). Bio, after owner approval: «Музыкальные инструменты · Астана, ул. Кажымукана, 14 · доставка по Казахстану» plus a wa.me link with a bio code. Highlights: «Как заказать», «Доставка и возврат» (wording only from returns_14d / returns_conditions / delivery facts), «Цены» (site prices only, re-fetched).

Fastest test bed for non-follower reach. No account is linked; owner ask. If none exists, one is created in week 0 and treated as a cold start: no arm judgements on its first 5–10 posts. Original instrument sound only, no library music needed.

Zero-minute cross-post of every cut to the existing channel (3 620 subs, dormant since 2026-05-10). Secondary search line (≤20% effort): titles carry plain model names, e.g. «Alston AS-100BK + Hibilly Retro 30R — звук», «Casio PX-770 и AP-270 — сравнение», because plain model-name titles win on search (L002, L004). L003 shows these title tricks do not transfer to the Shorts feed, so this line is measured separately and not counted as a feed-arm result.

Warm base from week 1. Each week the 1–2 best videos go to Status. Broadcasts only to contacts who opted in. True, dated availability («есть в наличии», stock counts) appears only here, and only if re-checked the same day (≤48 h).

Payment only (Kaspi QR / Kaspi Pay / transfer, per the payments fact). No Kaspi shop was found in the inputs, so there is no Kaspi SKU attribution this sprint. If a Kaspi store exists, the owner says so and we add a directional featured-SKU vs prior-4-weeks comparison, labelled directional.

Proof and local intent: review requests at handover (never incentivised) and a refresh with real store photos from the shoot. Listing existence and rating are not yet in the inputs; the agent fetches them.
Optional zero-minute cross-post of the same cuts with the same codes. Not used for arm decisions.

Budget is 0 ₸. The boost question is deferred until a post qualifies under DR2 + DR9, at the earliest in week 2. Cap formula: avg_order × gross_margin × close_rate × 0.3. Illustration only, with margin and close rate as [ASSUMPTION]: guitar+amp basket 116 376 ₸ × 25% × 25% × 0.3 ≈ 2 180 ₸ per coded chat. Stop-loss after 5× the cap (≈10 900 ₸) if there are fewer than 3 coded chats. Click-to-WhatsApp within an Astana radius only, the owner sets the real cap, and an unconfirmed offer is never boosted.

measurement.success_metric: Orders from coded WhatsApp chats across the 4 test lines (digital pianos, beginner electric guitar + amp, ukuleles, «Распродажа»), with coded chats as the sub-count, by 2026-11-15. Orders: conservative 6 / expected 12 / stretch 20. Coded chats: conservative 25 / expected 50 / stretch 80. Baseline: 0 coded chats. Total inbound and close rate are unknown, so the week-0 count (2026-10-12…18) is the baseline and the targets are re-fixed as a multiple of it on 2026-11-01.
measurement.attribution: Per-video {CODE}, assigned by code, shown on screen for ≥2 s at the CTA, in the caption and in the pinned comment, plus a prefilled wa.me link in the bio and wherever links are clickable. Counted from the weekly WhatsApp export plus the staff labels «Видео» and «Оплачен». Site orders where the buyer gives a code are added. In the store, staff ask «назовите код из ролика» at the counter. Codeless chats are asked «Откуда о нас узнали?». Coded counts are reported as a FLOOR. Weekly total inbound vs the week-0 baseline is reported separately as an ESTIMATE of total effect. No Kaspi SKU attribution this sprint (no Kaspi shop in the inputs). The YouTube search line is reported separately. Code attribution window: 30 days per post.
leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ platform median, per platform (log ratio per engine). Uses the pooled music_instruments_retail median until 10 own posts, then the median of the last 15 own posts. TikTok is excluded from arm judgements for its first 5–10 posts (cold start)
3-second hold / skip rate and average % watched vs account median
shares + saves per 1,000 views (saves for practical_value and check_before_buy, shares for identity and honest_signal: the mechanism check)
comments per 1,000 views, and how many comments are usable as reply-video seeds
profile visits per 1,000 views
coded WhatsApp chats per 1,000 views, per line (piano / guitar+amp / ukulele / sale), plus coded chat→order rate
staff minutes per coded chat (for the should_we_do_social verdict)
measurement.review_cadence: Each post: 48 h read (allocation) and 7-day read (final). Weekly campaign read on Monday (ingest, posteriors, slate, shoot card) with the owner report (≤5 lines, ≤1 decision). Target re-fix against the week-0 baseline on 2026-11-01. Phase review and should_we_do_social verdict at week 4 (report 2026-11-16). Code attribution window: 30 days.

decision_rules: DR0 Publish gate (truth): no post goes out unless every price in it comes from a ledger fact ≤7 days old and every stock or quantity mention from one ≤48 h old, re-fetched by the agent on publish day. If a price changed, re-render the caption. If the item is out of stock, hold the post and swap in a reserve. Piano prices come only from the web_cifrovoe_pianino_… ids; px770_price, ap270_price and diff_pno are never used. Derived sums (e.g. guitar + amp >100 000 ₸) are recomputed from same-day prices.
DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and at 7 days, per platform against that platform's own baseline.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h, or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× median. Until there are 10 own posts on a platform, the median is the pooled vertical median; if that is not yet supplied, use [ASSUMPTION] 500, so the threshold is ≥1 500 views at 48 h. Action within 7 days: 2 follow-ups (part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment), pin it if conversion-relevant, put it on WhatsApp Status, and mark it boost-eligible. At ≥10× (≥5 000 on the assumed median) it becomes a series, and the owner hears «вирусный» as a tail event, not a plan.
DR3 Hook failure (3-s hold <0.7× account median): re-cut with a different first frame and hook text from the edit-time variants, repost ≥7 days later. Once only.
DR4 Body failure (hold fine, completion <0.7× median): shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode of that series. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: if cumulative views are ≥30 000 across platforms by 2026-11-08 but coded chats are <9 (30% of the ~30 planned by then), check CTA visibility, the code in the caption and pinned comment, the bio link and reply time before making more content.

DR-reply: if the week-0 export shows a median first reply above 60 min in working hours, conversion pieces (ID14, ID23 and later conversion episodes) wait until quick replies and a person on duty are in place. Attention and consideration pieces continue. The owner is told this is the top leak.
DR6 Sales-handling miss (coded chats on plan, orders <15% of coded chats): report where chats die and draft reply scripts. Price and offer remain the owner's call.
DR7 Attention-only arm (≥10 posts, ≥10 000 views, 0 coded chats while other arms convert): cap it at 1 post a week.
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts → drop to the exploration floor for this client. Its data stays in the pool.

DR-line (2026-11-01): a line with ≥3 posts and 0 coded chats drops to 1 slot a week. The line with the highest coded chats per 1k views gets the freed slot. This is an allocation decision, not a declared winner.

DR9 Boost: only DR2 posts with ≥1 coded chat or a conversion role, within the owner's cap (illustrative ≈2 180 ₸ per coded chat for the guitar+amp basket until the owner sets one). Stop-loss at 5× the cap with <3 coded chats, or when cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer or the word «финальная».

DR10 Capacity = stock: pause conversion pieces for a SKU when open coded chats about it reach 80% of its re-fetched site stock (e.g. PX-770 3 шт → pause at 3 open chats; AP-270 5 шт → at 4; Hibilly 2 units → at 2), or when stock is ≤1 without a same-day re-check. Shift that slot to trust or attention content or to an in-stock alternative. If chat volume pushes the median first reply above 15 min, slow conversion posting until it recovers.
DR11 Honesty kill-switch: if a comment credibly disputes a fact (price, spec, warranty, what's in the box), pause that series, verify against the site, and tell the owner the same day.

DR12 Pivot: by week 4 (2026-11-15), if no arm has P >0.6 and orders are <3 (25% of the expected 12), rerun step 3 with fresh chats and voice notes, diagnose the funnel, and send the owner an honest report with options: another line, warm base, the non-price offer, boost, or pause.
DR13 Claims: «winner» only with P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval. Otherwise say «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: card completion <80% for 2 weeks → fewer locations (max 2), shorter takes, more zero-staff library re-cuts.
DR15 Owner: if more than 30% of ideas are rejected, read the reasons and update the constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger before the next batch.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

DR-verdict (should_we_do_social, pre-registered): at week 4, compare coded orders per staff hour against the threshold the owner picked in week 0 (default: ≥12 coded orders in the sprint = continue; 6–11 = continue with the changes from the review; <6 = DR12 report).
learning_questions: Which line (digital piano / beginner guitar+amp / ukulele / sale) produces the most coded WhatsApp chats per 1,000 views and per staff minute, and which has the best coded chat→order rate?
Does the sound-first hero «Игрушка или нет?» (curiosity_gap / myth_check) produce coded chats, or only views and hold?
Do honest-limit pieces (ID08 anti_sell, ID06 with Casio service in Almaty and no bench) produce a higher chat→order rate than pure sound pieces?
Is the bottleneck actually conversion? What are the median first reply and close rate in the week-0 export, and where do chats die (after the price, after «подумаю», on delivery questions)?

Does the zero-staff line (library re-cuts ID08 and ID19, plus plain model-name YouTube Shorts titles) generate coded chats at 0 staff minutes, and does the search line behave differently from the feed?

owner_asks.ask: Здравствуйте, я ИИ-ассистент по роликам для Muzzone. Пришлите, пожалуйста, 15–30 последних чатов с покупателями из WhatsApp: откройте чат → ⋮ → «Экспорт чата» → «Без медиафайлов». Имена и номера удаляем сразу, наружу ничего не попадает. По умолчанию (если не пришлёте до 14.10 18:00): считаем базу по ярлыкам с понедельника, а время ответа и долю покупок принимаем как допущение.
owner_asks.why: Gives the baseline, close rate, median reply time and where chats die. This decides whether conversion (reply time) is the real bottleneck (DR-reply) and lets us re-fix the targets on 2026-11-01.

owner_asks.ask: Кого можно снимать: 1 — только руки, инструменты и голос, 2 — продавцов с лицом (с их согласия), 3 — и покупателей (с их согласия). По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 14.10 18:00.
owner_asks.why: A hard consent constraint. All week-1 ideas are face-free, so the default does not block anything.

owner_asks.ask: Что важнее продать за 5 недель: 1 — пианино, 2 — электрогитары и комбики, 3 — укулеле, 4 — «Распродажа», 5 — пробуем всё и смотрим по цифрам? И почему распродажа «Финальная»: 1 — закрытие/переезд, 2 — уходим от этих моделей, 3 — обычная распродажа без срока, 4 — есть дата (какая)? По умолчанию: 5; слово «финальная» и сроки в роликах не используем.
owner_asks.why: Line priority shifts slots. The sale reason is the only legitimate source of urgency, so without it there is no urgency language and the sale line stays thin.

owner_asks.ask: Можно ли обещать в роликах: «Напишите код — до оплаты пришлём видео именно вашего экземпляра» и «сыграем обе модели по видео»? 1 — да, оба, 2 — только второе, 3 — нет. По умолчанию: 3 (пишем «подскажем, какой под вашу задачу»).
owner_asks.why: A new non-price offer needs the owner's «да» (L8, F4). It removes the 'what will arrive' risk for out-of-town buyers (I04) and unlocks ID08's stronger CTA.

owner_asks.ask: Есть ли у магазина TikTok и Kaspi-магазин? Пришлите скриншоты статистики Instagram за 30 дней (Профессиональная панель → Статистика). По умолчанию: TikTok создаём сами на номер магазина, Kaspi — только оплата.

owner_asks.ask: Утвердите один раз шаблон ответа в WhatsApp: «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {КОД}. Подскажите, для кого инструмент и на какой бюджет ориентируетесь, — сразу скажем, что из этого есть в наличии и что подойдёт.» Отвечает ли на номер +7 701 0987734 тот, кто может ставить ярлыки? 1 — да, 2 — другой номер (какой). owner_asks.ask: Какой итог за 4 недели будет для вас «соцсети работают»: 1 — от 6 заказов по кодам, 2 — от 12, 3 — от 20? По умолчанию: 2.
owner_asks.why: Pre-registers the should_we_do_social verdict so week 4 gives a test result rather than an opinion.

owner_asks.ask: Идёт ли кабель в комплекте с гитарой Alston AS-100BK или комбиком Hibilly Retro 30R, и сколько стоит кабель отдельно? По умолчанию: в роликах про кабель цену не называем и про комплект не говорим.
owner_asks.why: NEEDS FACT for ID23 and ID11 (the cable line), if the agent's site re-fetch doesn't settle it.

owner_asks.ask: Каждую неделю (среда): одобрите 5 роликов одним ответом — «да» / номера, которые убрать. По умолчанию: без вашего «да» ничего не публикуем.
owner_asks.why: L8: nothing goes outward without approval. Weekly owner time ≤5 min.

risks: NEEDS FACT: whether a guitar cable is included with the Alston AS-100BK or the Hibilly Retro 30R, and its price (agent re-fetch, then owner). Blocks the cable line in ID23 and any inclusion claim in ID11.

NEEDS FACT: a staff member who can play 3 basic chords cleanly (staff reality scan, week 0). Blocks ID01, ID15 and the chord tail of ID23/ID11. Fallback: reorder to ID06, ID14 (one-finger chord), ID08 and ID19.
NEEDS FACT: owner OK for the CTA «сыграем обе модели по видео» (ID08) and for the «видео вашего экземпляра до оплаты» offer. Until then, use the fallback CTA «подскажем, какой под вашу задачу».
NEEDS FACT: reason and end date of «Финальная распродажа» (owner). Until answered, no «финальная», no deadline and no urgency in any copy.
NEEDS FACT: real location names and light/noise (staff reality scan). «гитарная стена», «зал с пианино» and «тихий угол» are provisional.

Price expiry: the 2026-10-08 facts (as100, hib, u246, usc40) expire 2026-10-15, before any week-1 publish date. Every publish needs a same-day re-fetch (DR0). Piano prices are volatile (E23), and px770_price, ap270_price and diff_pno are do_not_use.

Thin stock: the Hibilly is a sale item with about 2 units, and the ukuleles are only 4 models in stock. A sell-out mid-week hits ID01, ID23, ID11, ID15 and ID14. DR10 holds them and swaps in reserves.
Owner reachable only via Andrey and Pavel: approval delays can push publish days. No publish without approval (L8), so week 1 may compress to Thu–Sun.
Conversion stage unknown: if replies are slow, content cannot fix it (DR-reply). Reported first.

Week-1 first-frame repetition: ID06 and ID08 both open on hands on piano keys (spaced Thu/Sun, glissando vs library phrase with spec cards). ID01 and ID23 share the gear but differ in first-frame type. The veteran-creator review may still flag this.
Week-1 mix deviates from the F3 sales_push default (reach 20% instead of 40%). Judgement call to avoid the ID01/ID15 first-frame clash. Corrected in week 2 with ID15 and ID19.

ID19 library re-cut: the gear may no longer be sold (no price or availability claims), the reveal must match the original test exactly, and any face must be cropped or blurred. ID08 library pos 14 may show a third-party brand or faces: crop or blur.
ID14: the chord shown must really be C (3rd fret, A string); verify in the edit. Gift timing is an assumption (E49): New Year is pre-tested now and scaled in sprint 2, planned 10–14 days ahead.
Returns guardrail: no EQ or processing that flatters the sound beyond what the buyer will hear. Overselling triggers 14-day returns with shipping withheld both ways (returns_cost).

Never in audience copy: «100% оригинальный товар» (absolute, no third-party source), the review-for-delivery-compensation clause, competitor or other-seller names, children at the piano without a parent's written OK.

Cold start: TikTok (new) and Shorts (channel dormant since 2026-05-10) give noisy early reach, so no arm judgements on the first 5–10 TikTok posts. Instagram baseline unknown until screenshots arrive.
Power: 5 posts a week cannot prove an arm within the sprint (≈30 posts per arm needed for a 2× effect). Per-client decisions are allocation only; knowledge comes from the pooled vertical data.
NEXT BATCH: hero «Игрушка или нет?» episodes 2–6 on other in-stock SKUs (ukulele U-246 22 100 ₸, Hibilly alone, a sale cymbal), so the hero can run at 2 per week from week 2.
NEXT BATCH: a dedicated «Распродажа» line idea (I09) and cymbal/drum close-sound loops (I08). The slate covers the sale line only through the Hibilly price.

NEXT BATCH: policy_story on the 14-day return, 12-month minimum warranty and Casio 2-year warranty (I05), an exact-unit proof idea (I04), a pinned «Как заказать» post, and reply videos from week-1 comments.

output.persona: Boss of Muzzone (music instrument store, Astana). I asked for more sales through social media, and my staff have one phone and 20 minutes a week between them. I care whether this sells instruments, what it costs my people, and whether anything in it could embarrass the store or turn out to be untrue.
output.best_idea: ID23 «Сколько на самом деле стоит начать на электрогитаре», together with the WhatsApp code system. It is the only piece that is clearly about selling a basket: guitar plus amp, over the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery line, with a CTA that asks the customer to let us assemble the set. Counting coded chats and orders rather than views is the right measure for me. ID01 (clean vs drive, «игрушка?») is the strongest hook and should lead. Both ideas, though, stand on a clearance amp we only have about 2 of (see refutations).

refutations.target: Staff time budget: week-1 shoot card «~15 минут» and the ≤17 min/week claim
refutations.why_fails: The week-1 session films ID01, ID06, ID14, ID23, ID11 and ID15. That is 15 separate shots at 2 takes each, about 30 takes, at two locations. It also means plugging in the guitar and amp, carrying the guitar and amp to the counter, putting the ukulele in its case and moving the phone between the piano and the guitar wall. Realistically that is 30–45 minutes, not 15. On top of that, the plan quietly adds ongoing work that is not counted in the 20 minutes: labelling every chat «Видео»/«Оплачен», asking «назовите код из ролика» at the counter, sending weekly 30-second voice notes, and asking customers for on-camera consent. The plan says it fits 20 minutes, and it doesn't.
refutations.fix: Time one real session in week 0 and plan from that measured number. Cut the week-1 bank to 4 worker ideas (drop banking ID11/ID15, or film them in week 2). List the chat-labelling minutes as a separate, explicit ask, or have the agent do the labelling from the export instead.

refutations.target: ID08 «Не переплачивайте за пианино» – claim «Разница на бумаге — полифония: 128 и 192»
refutations.why_fails: I doubt the claim is true. The PX-770 and the AP-270 also differ in speaker/amplifier output, in cabinet (the Celviano has a key lid and a furniture cabinet), and probably in tones and features. Saying the only paper difference is polyphony is the kind of claim a knowledgeable commenter will publicly disprove (DR11), which would embarrass us. It also actively talks customers out of my most expensive in-stock item (AP-270, 734 886 ₸, 5 units). That costs about 213 000 ₸ of revenue per diverted sale, in a sprint meant to raise sales.
refutations.fix: Do a full spec diff from the site's spec tables, not a partial one, and show every real difference (speakers, cabinet, lid). Reframe as «чем на самом деле отличаются», not «не переплачивайте». The CTA becomes «сыграем обе — решите на слух», so the AP-270 still gets a fair hearing.

refutations.target: ID01 / ID23 / ID11 / ID15 all depend on the Hibilly Retro 30R
refutations.why_fails: Four of the eight slate ideas, including the hero episode, the main conversion piece and the free-delivery basket, are built on a clearance amp with about 2 units in stock. If 2 people buy it in week 1, the hero series, the basket math (116 376 ₸ > 100 000 ₸) and the banked footage are all dead. DR10 would then pause the very content that worked. Using the hero to sell off a clearance item is not a repeatable series.
refutations.fix: Shoot the guitar+amp demos with a regularly stocked amp that has a price over about 40 300 ₸ (so the basket still crosses 100 000 ₸). Use the Hibilly only in a sale-line piece. Check stock for the replacement amp before shooting, not just on publish day.

refutations.target: Owner ask #1: export 15–30 WhatsApp chats to the AI assistant
refutations.why_fails: These are customer chats with names, phone numbers and possibly addresses. Exporting them to an outside AI vendor before anyone strips the names, without the customers' consent, is a personal-data risk under Kazakhstan's personal-data law. The promise «имена и номера удаляем сразу» comes after the data has already left the store. If this leaks or a customer complains, it is my store's problem, not the vendor's.
refutations.fix: Let the staff (or me) count the baseline locally instead: number of new chats per week, time to first reply on 10 chats, and how many ended in payment, typed into a 5-row table. Get raw exports only after confirming legal grounds, with names removed on the phone before sending.

refutations.target: Timeline vs buying cycle: 5-week sprint, week 0 has no posts, verdict on 2026-11-15
refutations.why_fails: The first post is around 2026-10-21, so there are only about 3.5 weeks of content. A parent choosing a 520–735k ₸ piano does not buy within days of seeing a Reel. With a cold-start TikTok and a YouTube channel dormant since May, it is plausible that by 15.11 there are almost no orders. The pre-registered «<6 = DR12 report» could then tell me «social doesn't sell» because the window was too short, not because the approach failed.
refutations.fix: Keep the 15.11 checkpoint for chats per line. Give the should_we_do_social verdict on orders at around 2026-12-15, which also covers the New Year gift peak for ukuleles and guitars. Report coded chats still open, not just closed orders.

refutations.target: Owner asks (9 items) and approval path via Andrey and Pavel
refutations.why_fails: The asks add up to 17 minutes against a stated ≤15-minute onboarding. Every week also needs a «да» relayed through two intermediaries. The deadlines don't match each other: the clarifying questions are due 10.10 18:00, which is today, while the owner asks are due 14.10. With the «no publish without approval» rule, relay delays will push publish days and squeeze week 1 to Thu–Sun, as the plan itself admits.
refutations.fix: Cut the onboarding to 3 asks: line priority, the «Финальная» reason and consent level, all with defaults. Make weekly approval silence-as-yes after 24 h for content that uses only verified facts and no faces. Explicit «да» stays required for offers, faces and spend. Use one deadline: 14.10.

refutations.target: Targets and realism math (12 orders, 25% close rate, 500 views per short on dormant or new accounts)
refutations.why_fails: Every number in the forecast is an assumption: close rate, chats per 1k (with a 10× range), views. The stated ratio of 0.3–3.0 means anywhere from failure to success. I am being asked to commit staff time to a target the plan admits is made up until 01.11. That is honest, but it gives me no way to judge ROI today.
refutations.fix: State the decision criterion up front in plain terms: «если к 01.11 меньше X кодовых чатов в неделю при Y просмотрах — сокращаем до 2 роликов в неделю». Also state what the AI editing and agent service costs me per month, so cost per order can actually be computed.

refutations.target: ID23 cable line «И кабель — без него не подключить» with no price
refutations.why_fails: A video promising «сколько на самом деле стоит» that then leaves out the cable price breaks its own promise and looks evasive. It is the same hidden-cost problem the video claims to solve.
refutations.fix: Settle the cable fact in week 0 by checking the site. If it is still unknown, drop the cable shot and do not publish the «на самом деле» hook.

refutations.target: ID19 library re-cut and ID15 POV (reach arms)
refutations.why_fails: ID19 uses gear we may not sell any more, still has an unfilled placeholder («Ответ: [по исходному тесту]») and cannot carry prices. ID15 is pure entertainment with brand_link 2. Neither moves my sales goal. They cost little staff time, but they take publishing slots and my approval attention.
refutations.fix: Keep at most one reach piece per week. Replace ID19 with a re-cut of the 64 000-view beginner guitar video that features gear currently in stock.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local retail in Kazakhstan/CIS. I've shot hundreds of shop Reels and TikToks on staff phones and judge plans by whether one tired seller can film it between customers, and whether it brings DMs rather than just views.
output.best_idea: ID14 (ukulele chord with one finger, as a gift). It needs about 3 minutes of staff time. An unplugged ukulele at 20 cm records cleanly even on a weak phone. The payoff is visible in the first frame and true on camera. It gives gift buyers a reason to forward it, and it ends on two concrete prices. ID19 comes second: re-cutting the shop's own old A/B test costs 0 minutes, and the ear-test game reliably gets people commenting «А или Б» in the CIS. Ship both of these first, whatever happens to the rest.

refutations.target: Week 1 shoot card «~15 минут» (ID01, ID06, ID14, ID23 + banked ID11, ID15)
refutations.why_fails: That is 6 videos, 15 shots and about 30 takes across 2 rooms. Each needs setup: plugging in the amp, setting gain clean then drive, retuning, moving to the piano hall, clearing the spot in front of the piano, then the counter top-down for ID23, then sending files. Raw footage alone is about 3.5 min, and real store time with customers walking in is 30–45 min. That is 2–3× the hard 17 min/week cap. Staff will do half, skip the rest, and the card-completion rule DR14 fires in week 2. One more trap: if they send the files through WhatsApp as video, they get compressed to mush. The card has to say «отправьте как документ/файл».
refutations.fix: Week 1 = one location per session, max 4 videos. Do guitar wall only on Tuesday: ID01, ID15 and the ID11 jack click all share one amp setup and use the same 3 takes. Do ID14 in the same spot because the ukulele hangs there. Move ID06 to a separate 5-min piano session in week 2. Drop ID23's 3 placing shots and cut it from the ID01/ID11 footage instead. Put the timing in the card per shot («шаг 1 — 2 мин») and add «отправить как файл».

refutations.target: ID01 / ID15 hero: overdrive through Hibilly, filmed on a weak phone at 20 cm from the speaker
refutations.why_fails: Cheap phone mics clip and auto-gain on distortion at 20 cm. The drive section will sound like fizzy broken noise. So the answer to «Игрушка?» on screen becomes «yes, it sounds like a toy», which kills the hero and the whole «Послушайте, прежде чем платить» promise. The plan forbids EQ, which is correct, so nothing can rescue it in the edit. The week-0 audio test only covers clean guitar plus piano, not drive.
refutations.fix: Add a drive test to week 0: amp master on 2–3, gain at half, phone 40–50 cm off-axis (not facing the cone), 10 s. If it clips, the hero becomes clean vs. a different chord or register, and ID15 is parked. Also, film in a quiet hour: store noise plus amp hum is the usual killer.

refutations.target: Conversion mechanic: «Напишите в WhatsApp {CODE}» as the only counted inbound
refutations.why_fails: KZ shop audiences don't type codes. They comment «цена?» or «есть в наличии?», or write to Instagram Direct, and many open WhatsApp and send a screenshot of the video. Reels have no clickable link except the bio. So the coded-chat floor will be near zero even if the videos work, and DR5/DR7 will 'kill' arms that are actually producing inquiries in Direct and comments. Alphanumeric codes like G01 also read as bureaucratic, like an ad.
refutations.fix: Use word codes people actually send: «напишите «ГИТАРА» / «ПИАНИНО» / «УКУЛЕЛЕ»» (one word per line, plus a 2-letter suffix per video only in the prefilled wa.me text). Count Instagram Direct, TikTok DMs and «цена» comments as inquiries with the same «Видео» label, and add a staff rule: reply to each «цена» comment with the price plus «пишите в WhatsApp». Reply to comments within 1 h, because the algorithm and the buyer both reward it.

refutations.target: ID08 (screen-recorded product pages + cropped 16:9 library clip)
refutations.why_fails: Scrolling a website spec sheet is the most ad-like, least stopping format on TikTok/Reels. It is basically the price slide L005 already bans. The library crop from a horizontal comparison video will be soft and may show the other brand. «Не переплачивайте» is a good hook wasted on a screencast.
refutations.fix: Keep the hook, change the body. In the same 5-min piano session, play the same 4-bar phrase on the PX-770 and then the AP-270, phone fixed at 25 cm, with the specs as 2 caption lines only («128 / 192 полифония», prices). That makes it an ear test, the format that works for you. Screencast only as a 2-s insert, if at all.

refutations.target: ID06 «Пианино в музыкалку: проверьте три вещи»
refutations.why_fails: The 'checks' are not checks a parent can use. «88 клавиш» is obvious, «банкетки нет» is a store minus framed as advice, and «сервис Casio в Алматы» is a reason for an Astana parent not to buy. None of these is what a music-school teacher tells parents to check. The video saves nothing, and it reads as a disclaimer, not utility.
refutations.fix: Use the real teacher checks, each shown on the PX-770 by hand. 1) Weighted (hammer) keys: press slowly and show the resistance. 2) 3 pedals on a stand, not one loose pedal: tap the pedal. 3) Headphone jack for practice at night: plug in the headphones. Keep the warranty line honest in the caption, not as the payoff. Hook: «Учитель в музыкалке спросит про эти 3 вещи».

refutations.target: ID23 «Сколько на самом деле стоит начать»
refutations.why_fails: Hands placing items plus a running price total is a catalogue ad, and its 'forgotten item' payoff (the cable) is an unconfirmed fact. If the cable price and inclusion can't be shown, the twist is empty. The free delivery over 100 000 ₸ also means nothing to the Astana majority.
refutations.fix: Merge it into the ID01 ending as the final 4 s («весь старт: гитара + комбик = X ₸, по Казахстану доставка бесплатно»). Replace the separate ID23 slot with ID19 (0 staff minutes) in week 1.

refutations.target: Faceless-only rule across the whole slate + generic comment prompts
refutations.why_fails: In KZ local retail, the seller's face and voice («я Пётр, продаю гитары 10 лет») is the trust and DM driver. Twenty hand-only videos read like supplier B-roll and blur into every Kaspi seller. Prompts like «Ваша первая гитара была дешёвой или дорогой?» get 0–2 replies.
refutations.fix: Bring the consent ask forward to week 0 with a concrete pitch: one seller saying a single sentence on camera at the end of each video. Use binary or provocative prompts: «Игрушка или нет? Да / нет в комменты», «Сколько дадите за эту гитару, не глядя на цену?».

refutations.target: Owner onboarding asks (9 asks, ~17 min) + 5 series for 5 posts a week
refutations.why_fails: The asks break the ≤15 min onboarding cap and are relayed through 2 intermediaries, so half will come back unanswered and approvals will slip. Five series at 5 posts a week means no series repeats often enough for viewers to recognise it.
refutations.fix: Send the owner 4 asks: chat export, consent, the number and template, the offer «да/нет». Everything else gets a default. Run 2 recognisable series in sprint 1 (the «Игрушка или нет?» ear test + «Проверьте перед покупкой»). The rest are just formats inside them.

output.name: Muzzone: «Послушайте, прежде чем платить» (Sprint 1 revised: diagnostic sales push, posting 2026-10-21 → 2026-11-15 chats checkpoint, order verdict 2026-12-15)
output.big_idea: An online buyer can't judge an instrument from a spec sheet or a price tag. So we play regularly stocked instruments up close in the Astana store: hands only, the phone near the strings, keys or speaker, recorded in a quiet hour. Where a second model is in stock, we play the two side by side so the buyer can hear the difference and decide by ear. We also state plainly what the whole start costs and what is and isn't in the box. Each episode ends with one word (ГИТАРА / ПИАНИНО / УКУЛЕЛЕ) that the viewer can send in WhatsApp, Direct or a comment to ask about that model. The in-stock catalogue supports 20+ episodes. Each one is proven by sound on camera, and each points at a countable inquiry.
output.why_this_wins:
This is a reasoned bet and a learning plan, not a forecast (L1).
(1) It sits on the strongest tension. I01 (strength 4; E01, E02, E12–E17, E50): buyers fear a cheap first guitar is a toy and can't hear that from a catalogue. ID01 answers this with the real sound of the AS-100BK (as100_price, 59 800 ₸, 11 in stock per the site sample, re-fetched on publish day).
REVISED: the guitar+amp pieces are no longer built on the 2-unit clearance Hibilly. They use a regularly stocked amp (NEEDS FACT, fetched in week 0) priced above 40 200 ₸, so the basket still crosses delivery_free_100k. The Hibilly moves to a separate sale-line piece in the next batch.
(2) The high-ticket line now runs as an ear test, not a spec screencast. REVISED ID08: the same phrase is played on the PX-770 and then the AP-270, with the phone fixed. On screen we show only verified differences: 128 vs 192 polyphony (px770_specs, ap270_specs), plus every other difference the agent's full spec-table fetch confirms. The AP-270 gets a fair hearing. The video does not tell anyone to buy the cheaper model.
REVISED ID06: the checklist becomes three checks a parent can do by hand on the PX-770 (key resistance, pedals, headphone jack). Each is shown on camera, and spec wording waits for a NEEDS FACT. The Casio 2-year warranty and Almaty service (warranty_casio) move to the caption, stated honestly.
(3) I06 plus delivery_free_100k make the content a basket (ID23). I07 pre-tests the gift line with the U-246 at 22 100 ₸ and the US-C40 at 32 901 ₸, both sold with a case (u246_specs, usc40_specs).
(4) It avoids what already failed for this client: brand-only demos (L006: median 390 vs 2 300, n=48), price slides and screencasts (L005). Every piece opens on motion and real sound with no faces. Drive sound is used only if the week-0 phone test shows it doesn't clip, so the format can't make our own gear sound like a toy.
(5) The message is true by construction (every episode plays the item), and it is not a superiority claim. [ASSUMPTION] peers don't say it; check against the peer scan.
(6) Learning plan. Week 1 (2026-10-19…25): 4 posts across 4 drivers, from one guitar-wall session (guitar+amp ×3, ukulele ×1). Week 2: a separate 1-location piano session (ID06, ID08) plus banked ID11, ID15. Inquiries are counted across WhatsApp word codes, Direct/DMs and «цена» comments, because coded WhatsApp alone would undercount KZ buyers. On 2026-11-15 we read inquiries per line, counting open chats as well as closed ones. The should_we_do_social verdict on orders moves to 2026-12-15, so piano buying cycles and the New Year gift peak are inside the window.

series.name: «Игрушка или нет?»
series.role: HERO. Funnel: attention→consideration. Metric: views_48h ÷ median, plus video-attributed inquiries per 1k per line. Fixed opening: frame 1 is a hand already playing a REGULARLY STOCKED instrument (≥2 units, not from the sale list), real sound from 0.0 s, recorded in the store's quiet hour, with the hook «[Инструмент] за [ledger price] — игрушка?» upper-middle. Structure: clean sound → one turn → the viewer judges by ear → same-day ledger price → CTA word. The turn is the gain knob ONLY if the week-0 drive test passed. Otherwise it is a pickup switch, a different chord or a different register. Variable per episode: the instrument. ≤3 staff min per episode, 1 location. Ep. 1 = ID01, shot with the replacement amp. Never built on 1–2-unit clearance stock.
series.cadence: 1 in week 1. From week 3: up to 2 per week if next-batch episodes are approved; code shifts this by data

series.name: «Проверьте перед покупкой»
series.role: PROOF + UTILITY. Funnel: consideration. Metric: saves per 1k and the inquiry→order rate on piano and guitar. Opening ritual: hands already doing the check (keys pressed slowly, jack click), and a hook naming the purchase situation. Structure: numbered checks a buyer can do with their own hands, each shown on a real in-stock item. Honest limits (warranty terms, service city) go in the caption, never as the payoff. Episodes: REVISED ID06 (keys / pedals / headphone jack on the PX-770) and ID11 (first electric guitar, box to first chord, with the replacement amp).
series.cadence: 1 per week in weeks 2–3, then by allocation

series.name: «Послушайте разницу»
series.role: CONSIDERATION + REACH. Funnel: consideration. Metric: completion, comments per 1k («А или Б?») and piano/guitar inquiries per 1k. Opening ritual: sound already playing on option A, with an A/B label upper-middle. Structure: the same phrase on two instruments, phone fixed → the stake → the true reveal or the verified spec difference → CTA word. Episodes: REVISED ID08 (PX-770 vs AP-270, filmed live, re-tagged by code as ab_compare / curiosity_gap) and ID19 (library ear test, zero staff minutes).

series.name: «С чего начать»
series.role: CONVERSION. Funnel: conversion. Metric: video-attributed inquiries per 1k, and orders over 100 000 ₸ (delivery_free_100k basket). Opening ritual: the instrument in action for a named starter situation (a first electric guitar, a gift for someone who doesn't play). Structure: the starter set at same-day ledger prices → what's included (case «Да», bench «Нет») → the free-delivery threshold only if same-day prices cross it → CTA word. ID23 is cut from week-1 guitar-wall footage, with no new shots.
series.cadence: 1–2 per week; paused per SKU by DR10

series.name: «Звук вблизи»
series.role: REACH. Funnel: attention. Metric: relative views and shares per 1k. Opening ritual: sound onset in frame 1, no talking, a «постановка» label where staged. ID15 (POV first overdrive) runs ONLY if the week-0 drive test passed; otherwise it is parked and its slot goes to the next-batch cymbal/drum loops (I08).
series.cadence: from week 2: up to 1 per week (exploration slot)

series.name: «Ответ на комментарий»
series.role: REPLY. Funnel: retention/consideration. Metric: comments and follows per 1k. Starts once real comments exist. Built from library footage plus at most 1 new shot. No slate ids yet: next batch.
series.cadence: from week 2: 1 per week if real comments exist

offer.proposal: Новых скидок не предлагаем. Уже действует и упоминается точно как на сайте: «Бесплатная доставка по Казахстану (наземным транспортом) при заказе свыше 100 000 ₸». Цены распродажи — только как опубликованы на сайте в день публикации, без слова «финальная» и без сроков. КАНДИДАТ (неценовое, только после вашего «да»): «Напишите слово из ролика в WhatsApp — до оплаты пришлём короткое видео именно того экземпляра, который вы покупаете: внешний вид и звук. decision_rules: DR0 Publish gate (truth): every price must come from a ledger fact ≤7 days old, and every stock mention from one ≤48 h old, re-fetched on publish day. Piano prices come only from the web_cifrovoe_pianino_… ids; px770_price, ap270_price and diff_pno are never used. Derived sums (guitar + amp >100 000 ₸) are recomputed from same-day prices, and the post is held if the sum doesn't cross. Every spec difference in ID06 and ID08 must map to a ledger fact from the full spec-table fetch; anything unverified is cut, never softened.

DR-amp (shoot gate): guitar+amp content is filmed only with a regularly stocked amp (not on the sale list, ≥2 units on shoot day, price >40 200 ₸). Stock is checked BEFORE the shoot, not just on publish day. If none qualifies: ID01 is shot on the AS-100BK through whichever in-stock amp has the most units, with no amp price and no basket claim; ID23 is held; and the Hibilly appears only in a sale-line piece (next batch).

DR-drive (audio gate): overdrive content (ID15, ID01's gain turn) runs only if the week-0 drive clip (amp master 2–3, gain ½, phone 40–50 cm off-axis, quiet hour) has no audible clipping or auto-gain pumping. If it fails, ID01's turn becomes a pickup switch, chord or register change, and ID15 is parked. No EQ or processing ever tries to rescue the sound.

DR-staff-time: every card is planned as formula minutes × the factor measured in the week-0 timed session, including setup and file sending, capped at 12 card minutes. Plus labels 1 + tally 3 + voice note 1 = ≤17 planned min a week. One location per session, ≤4 filmed ideas per card. If the forecast exceeds 12, the lowest-priority shot is cut before the card is sent.
DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and at 7 days, per platform against its own baseline.

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h, or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× median. Until there are 10 own posts, use the pooled vertical median, or [ASSUMPTION] 500 → ≥1 500 views if none is supplied. Action within 7 days: 2 follow-ups (part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment), cut from banked footage where possible; pin if conversion-relevant; WhatsApp Status; boost-eligible. At ≥10× it becomes a series, and the owner hears «вирусный» only as a tail event.
DR3 Hook failure (3-s hold <0.7× account median): re-cut with a different first frame and hook from the edit-time variants, repost ≥7 days later. Once only.
DR4 Body failure (hold fine, completion <0.7× median): shorten and move the payoff earlier in that series' next episode.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: cumulative views ≥30 000 by 2026-11-08 but ALL video-attributed inquiries (WhatsApp + Direct/DM + «цена» comments) below 9. Check the word visibility, the caption and pinned comment, the bio link, comment-reply latency (≤1 h) and WhatsApp reply time before making more content. Arms are never judged on coded WhatsApp alone.

DR-reply: if the week-0 tally shows a median first reply >60 min in working hours, conversion pieces (ID14, ID23, later conversion episodes) wait until the quick reply and a person on duty are in place. The owner is told this is the top leak.

DR6 Sales-handling miss: inquiries on plan but orders below 15% of inquiries at 30 days → report where chats stall (from the tally's top questions) and draft reply scripts. Price and offer stay the owner's call. Piano inquiries are judged at the 2026-12-15 verdict, not at 7 days.
DR7 Attention-only arm: ≥10 posts, ≥10 000 views and 0 attributed inquiries in any channel while other arms convert → capped at 1 post a week.
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts → exploration floor for this client. Its data stays in the pool.

DR-line (2026-11-15 checkpoint): a line with ≥3 posts and 0 attributed inquiries drops to 1 slot a week; the line with the most inquiries per 1k gets the slot. Allocation only, never a declared winner.

DR9 Boost: only DR2 posts with ≥1 attributed inquiry or a conversion role, within the owner's cap. Stop-loss at 5× the cap with <3 attributed inquiries, or when cost per inquiry rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer, the word «финальная» or a SKU with ≤1 unit.

DR10 Capacity = stock: pause conversion pieces for a SKU when open attributed inquiries about it reach 80% of its re-fetched stock (e.g. PX-770 3 шт → at 3; AP-270 5 шт → at 4; the replacement amp → at 80% of its fetched count), or when stock is ≤1 without a same-day re-check. The slot shifts to an in-stock alternative or to trust/attention content. If inquiry volume pushes the median first reply above 15 min, conversion posting slows.

DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact (price, spec, what's in the box, a difference claimed in ID08) → pause that series, verify against the site's full spec table, tell the owner the same day.

DR12 Pivot: at the 2026-11-15 checkpoint, no arm with P >0.6 and attributed inquiries <13 (25% of the expected 50) → rerun step 3 with fresh tallies and staff voice notes, diagnose the funnel, and send the owner options (another line, warm base, the non-price offer, boost, pause). Order-based pivots wait for 2026-12-15.
DR13 Claims: «winner» only with P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval. Otherwise «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: card completion <80% for 2 weeks → re-time a session, shorter takes, more face-free shots and zero-staff library re-cuts. Never more than 1 location per session.
DR15 Owner: >30% of ideas rejected → read the reasons and update constraints. A fact rejection means fixing the ledger first.
DR16 Flops are never deleted, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

DR-privacy: no raw WhatsApp export is requested or accepted until the owner confirms legal grounds for processing customer chats and names and numbers are removed on the phone before sending. Until then, only the staff's 5-row tally and anonymous counts are used.

DR-verdict (should_we_do_social, pre-registered, 2026-12-15): orders from video-attributed inquiries vs the owner's threshold (default ≥12 = continue; 6–11 = continue with review changes; <6 = DR12 report). Open inquiries are reported alongside. Staff minutes per order use the measured factor.
